class.description: DOD NOTE: GamePropertyGauge (which also serves as GamePropertyBar when `display_mode == GAUGE_DISPLAY_LINEAR_BAR`) binds declaratively to a `GameEntity` by `ObjectID` and a `StringName` property title (e.g., `&"Health"`, `&"Stamina"`, `&"Shield"`), or ingests flat `Dictionary` telemetry snapshots directly. It visualizes three layers simultaneously: 1. Authoritative Base Value (`_value` / cached rule base value). 2. Effective Modded Value (`get_modded_value()`), highlighting positive buffs vs. negative debuffs from `GameplayRule` or `GamePropertyModifier`. 3. Active timed modifiers (`ModifierType::TIMED` / `TIMED_DIMINISHING`) via `CircularGauge` concentric rings and/or linear countdown bars. Part of IdeamGames (game agents, players, rules, scoring, and match orchestration).
